Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the commercialization of research at state universities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to commercialization of research at stateuniversities; amending RCW 42.52.160; and adding new sections tochapter 28B.63 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.63 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The mission of the state universities includes commercializingresearch that benefits the intermediate and longterm economic vitalityof Washington and developing and strengthening universityindustryrelationships through the conduct of research, support of companyformation and job creation, and engagement in state economicdevelopment programs. The state universities must: (a) Provide collaborative research and technology transferopportunities; (b) Publicize their commercialization processes and include anexplanation of how to access commercialization resources at theuniversity; (c) Develop mechanisms for pairing researchers, entrepreneurs, andinvestors, which includes, but is not limited to: p. 1 SB 6706 (i) Developing a funding resource guide; (ii) Offering workshops on how to access financing forcommercializing new technologies; (iii) Providing opportunities for novice investors to learn aboutinvesting in companies developed using universitybased research; (iv) Hosting events to connect researchers, entrepreneurs, andinvestors; and (v) Maintaining an interactive web site accessible by researchers,entrepreneurs, and investors; (d) Provide opportunities for training undergraduate and graduatestudents through direct involvement in research and industryinteractions; and (e) Conduct forums for interaction and collaboration betweenindividuals from the state's technologybased industries and itsacademic institutions. (2) In carrying out the duties in this section, the universitiesmay work with and through the higher education coordinating board.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.63 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: To facilitate the creation of companies based on universityresearch, the state universities are authorized to establish andadminister bridgefunding programs for startup companies using fundsfrom the federal government and the private sector.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.52.160 and 1996 c 213 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No state officer or state employee may employ or use anyperson, money, or property under the officer's or employee's officialcontrol or direction, or in his or her official custody, for theprivate benefit or gain of the officer, employee, or another. (2) This section does not prohibit the use of public resources tobenefit others as part of a state officer's or state employee'sofficial duties. (3) University research employees may use public resources tofacilitate the formation of companies using universitybased research. (4) The appropriate ethics boards may adopt rules providing SB 6706 p. 2 exceptions to this section for occasional use of the state officer orstate employee, of de minimis cost and value, if the activity does notresult in interference with the proper performance of public duties.
